title: Versioned Coordinator lease and claim fencing state machine

operations.claim: CAS current revision; open task and no owner only; create one lease and advance revision
operations.heartbeat: CAS current revision; current owner, lease, and fence only; strictly advance monotonic time and expiry
operations.handoff: CAS current revision; current unexpired owner atomically replaced by one new owner and fence
operations.recover_expired: CAS current revision; only an expired owner is replaced, atomically and with a new fence
operations.release: CAS current revision; current owner and fence only; clear the owner and advance revision

invariants: At most one active owner exists at every committed revision.
Every ownership replacement strictly increases the fencing token.
Every mutating operation compares the exact current CAS revision.
An old owner, lease, or fence cannot act after handoff or expiry recovery.
Operation IDs are single-use; identical replay returns the original response and changed replay rejects.
An ambiguous commit is never guessed; retry by operation ID is the only resolution.

durability.commit: state and operation result commit atomically before success is observable
durability.recovery: ambiguous outcome remains unknown until the same operation ID is replayed

time.rule: heartbeats and lease expiry are strictly monotonic

failure_semantics.external_effects: none: no network, Coordinator repository, provider, Git, or durable-state mutation

limitations: This is a deterministic local model and does not prove a distributed transport or filesystem atomicity.
Live Coordinator, hosted CI, remote execution, and production crash qualification remain unverified.
follow_up: Use the project-bound Coordinator transport for live qualification only after independent approval and security gates.
